decisions.statement: One tree belongs to one kind of deploy, named for that kind.
A tree sits under the folder every worktree of the checkout shares.
A tree is made once and moved to the commit after that.
Moving costs the files that differ rather than a checkout of the whole tree.
A file git does not track is left where it is when the tree moves.
A tree pinned at a commit carries the index the pages at that commit imply.
A tree git will not make or move is refused by naming the kind and the commit.
A tree whose index will not build is refused the same way.
Nothing here says which files a deploy is built from.
Nothing here takes a tree away.
One thing moves a kind's tree, and that is the deploy of that kind under its own hold.

definition: the tree a deploy of one kind is built from, pinned at that deploy's commit
